prompt: Why can removing items while iterating over the same list cause problems?
options: The list becomes immutable
Indices shift and some items may be skipped
Python stops supporting lists
It always sorts the list
whyEn: Removing an element shifts later indices while the iterator continues.
whyHi: Item remove hone par aage ke indices shift ho jaate hain, jisse items skip ho sakte hain.
promptHi: Same list par iterate karte hue items remove karne se problem kyun ho sakti hai?
optionsHi: List immutable ho jati hai
Indices shift ho jate hain aur kuch items skip ho sakte hain
Python lists support karna band kar deta hai
Ye hamesha list sort karta hai

prompt: What is a safer pattern when filtering a list?
options: Build a new list of items to keep
Delete every second item
Use sort()
Convert it to a string
whyEn: A new filtered list avoids mutating the sequence being iterated over.
whyHi: Nayi filtered list se iterate hoti hui original list mutate nahi hoti.
promptHi: List filter karne ka safer pattern kaunsa hai?
optionsHi: Jin items ko rakhna hai unki nayi list banayein
Har doosra item delete karein
sort() use karein
String mein convert karein
